newsitem.title: CHINA: China sets trial digital microwave phone network.
newsitem.headline: China sets trial digital microwave phone network.

text.p: China will launch a pilot project in an eastern province to speed the digitalisation of its long distance telephone network, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper said a high-capacity synchronous digital hierarchy microwave network would be installed to connect the cities of Yutai and Sishui in Shandong province.
It gave no details of the cost or timetable but it said the system was being developed by the Number Four Research Institute of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
